default.title: SP ENW - GIS - Conductor - Allerdale
default.description:
Dataset Classification - Shared

SP ENW - GIS - Conductors - Allerdale

This dataset depicts the sections of underground and overhead conductors, which are owned by SP ENW and are located within the referenced Local Authority area. This dataset does not knowingly contain any privately owned assets.

Due to the sensitivities associated to the information contained in this dataset, SP ENW have classified the openness of this dataset as 'Shared' - As such, it is currently only available to government departments, agencies, public bodies and local authorities.

Those users meeting the above criteria, can apply for access to this dataset by completing the Request Form HERE.

A specific 'Shared Data' licence has been developed for datasets classified in this manner, this licence can be accessed HERE. Any user requesting access to a 'Shared' dataset, are considered to have understood and accepted the specified Terms and Conditions of this licence.

While we use reasonable endeavours to ensure that the data contained within this dataset is accurate, we do not accept any responsibility or liability for the accuracy or the completeness of the content held, or for any loss which may arise from reliance on this dataset and/or its related information.

If you have any other query related to this SP ENW - GIS - Conductor dataset, please contact us  HERE
